g.text: Four corner bastions: the cabinets merge into four diagonal blocks, one per corner inside the runs' bends; the gear-houses sit on the north pair; the faces' middles are bare deck.
SOUTH ELEVATION (from the south; x right)
EAST ELEVATION (from the east; north right)
on N bastion (drive) (E, W) + N guide column (E, W):
front open on the gear; roof spans to the column
on frame post + frame post + plate:
on the plate top, borne: N bastion (drive) (E, W),
Runs: on the gallery (r 2.24) as T03h; on junction risers,
face saddles at 1.40, and over each open corner a cast girder
(ends set in the notch faces, two red-oxide posts on the
ground) with a saddle at the bend. Legs: root in the plate's
notch face, pad on the ground.

svg.text: red oxide (press frame, drive, rig frame)
base borne by what is under it
other directions' runs and fittings; pipe inside the plate
